tool_input.content:
version: 2
models:
  - name: can_client
    description: "Canonical client entity. One row per client (FSC account) enriched with primary advisor details and aggregate account metrics (total AUM, account count). Draws from res_client, res_client_advisor, res_advisor_book, res_client_account, and res_account_value."
    config:
      domain: 'Client'
    columns:
      - name: canonical_client_id
        description: "Surrogate key for this canonical row"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: client_id
        description: "FSC account ID representing the client household/individual"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: client_name
        description: "Resolved full name (first + last)"
      - name: first_name
        description: "Resolved first name"
      - name: last_name
        description: "Resolved last name"
      - name: email
        description: "Resolved client email"
      - name: phone
        description: "Resolved client phone"
      - name: state
        description: "Resolved client state"
      - name: city
        description: "Resolved client city"
      - name: zip
        description: "Resolved client zip code"
      - name: account_type
        description: "FSC account type: Individual, Household, Trust, etc."
      - name: client_segment
        description: "Client segment: HNW, UHNW, Mass Affluent, Institutional"
      - name: service_model
        description: "Service model tier assigned to the client"
      - name: risk_tolerance
        description: "Client risk tolerance profile"
      - name: investment_experience
        description: "Client investment experience level"
      - name: date_of_birth
        description: "Client date of birth"
      - name: relationship_start_date
        description: "Date the client relationship began"
      - name: account_count
        description: "Number of active financial accounts for this client"
      - name: total_aum
        description: "Total assets under management across all accounts"
      - name: advisor_id
        description: "Primary advisor FSC identifier"
      - name: advisor_name
        description: "Primary advisor full name"
      - name: advisor_rep_code
        description: "Primary advisor rep code"
      - name: advisor_team
        description: "Primary advisor team name"
      - name: advisor_region
        description: "Primary advisor team region"
      - name: client_match_status
        description: "Cross-system match quality: ALL_MATCHED, FSC_PERF, FSC_CUST, FSC_ONLY"
